title: Cyrus
summary: Raleigh names Cyrus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cyrus, named by Cedrenus and Curtius among the sonnes of Agenor. He is not Cyrus of Persia. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. I, sig. 232a
